import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from parallel_linear import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
def run(rank, ws, port):
    os.environ.update(MASTER_ADDR="127.0.0.1", MASTER_PORT=str(port))
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    I,O=8,12
    W=torch.randn(O,I); x=torch.randn(3,I)
    for cls in (ColumnParallelLinear,RowParallelLinear):
        ref=torch.nn.Linear(I,O); 
        with torch.no_grad(): ref.weight.copy_(W); ref.bias.zero_()
        m=cls(I,O,True,W.clone())
        xa=x.clone().requires_grad_(); xb=x.clone().requires_grad_()
        y=m(xa); yr=ref(xb)
        assert torch.allclose(y,yr,atol=1e-5)
        y.sum().backward(); yr.sum().backward()
        assert torch.allclose(xa.grad,xb.grad,atol=1e-5)
        if cls is ColumnParallelLinear:
            c=O//ws; sl=slice(rank*c,(rank+1)*c)
            assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad,ref.weight.grad[sl]); assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad,ref.bias.grad[sl])
        else:
            c=I//ws; sl=slice(rank*c,(rank+1)*c)
            assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad,ref.weight.grad[:,sl]); assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad,ref.bias.grad)
    if rank==0: print("ok ws",ws)
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__=="__main__":
    for i,ws in enumerate((1,2,4)): mp.spawn(run,args=(ws,29600+i),nprocs=ws)
